tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Plugin ground. The thesis ink colour. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, segmented-tab track. Text on it: text 15.3:1, muted 7.3:1, accent 9.5:1.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, hover rows, the active tab, neutral tags. Text on it: text 13.3:1, muted 6.4:1 (AA), accent 8.2:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers between panel regions only (1.55:1 on bg). Never the only cue for a control or a state.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-2 (16.8 / 15.3 / 13.3:1, AAA).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono labels, status words, and input and secondary-button borders (8.1 / 7.3 / 6.4:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber. Primary action fill, progress, done-check fill, focus ring, section numbers. As text on bg / surface / surface-2: 10.4 / 9.5 / 8.2:1. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill (10.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft accent ground for the active tag and the focus halo around fields. Accent text on it stays above 7:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Light thesis blue. Links, ghost buttons, selection outlines, code values (6.9 / 6.3 / 5.4:1, AA).

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Link and ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: blue-thesis
tokens.usage: The thesis accent. Fills, illustrations and the cover only. Never text on dark (2.99:1).

families.mono: "Red Hat Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: One per panel, with the ## marker at 45% opacity.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Sub-view titles, such as a detail or editor view.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Frame and layer names, card titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and status words, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Show the error below the field after blur.
styles.usage: Default UI text, list rows, field values.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Spec values, token names, handover previews.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text inside tight chips, tab track inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags and between stacked label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in rows, list side inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups, vertical padding of panel regions.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wider views.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Separation between major regions on wide views.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, rows, the active tab.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the tab track.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Progress bar ends.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs and icon buttons inside the panel (minimum target).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The primary footer action and checklist rows.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Default plugin window width.
